headings.usage: Use for all page titles, dashboard metrics, and card headers. Never use Inter or generic sans.

body.usage: Use for all table data, forms, and secondary text. Provides a structural, technical feel suitable for construction data.

labels.usage: Use for overlines, status indicators, and form field labels.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) mixed with Structural Industrial
rules: Use purely solid colors with high contrast.
Buttons for site engineers must use the bright Action color (#F97316) for high visibility on site.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Data-heavy dashboards should use border-collapse style layout with subtle borders (border-border/40). Avoid soft, floaty glassmorphism here; it's a construction app.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders on cards and inputs to ground the UI. Use rounded-md (not heavily rounded).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use sharp, distinct shadows only on hover for clickable items.

component_usage_rules.forms: Always use Shadcn components for inputs, selects, and dialogs. Must use large click areas (min-h-[48px]) for mobile field engineers.
component_usage_rules.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Make them dense for desktop (Project Managers, Billing) but convert to Card-based list views for Mobile (Site Engineers).
component_usage_rules.buttons: Large, rectangular with slight rounding (rounded-md). Always explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white.
component_usage_rules.status_tags: Pill-shaped, uppercase, utilizing the status_colors with strong border definition.

grids_and_spacing.philosophy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics) combined with Mobile-First generous tap targets.
grids_and_spacing.desktop: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_spacing.mobile: Mobile-First: Always start with grid-cols-1. Ensure fields have generous padding (p-4 or p-6).
grids_and_spacing.alignment: Paragraphs, labels, inputs left-aligned. Status badges and action buttons right or left aligned depending on context.

layouts.navigation: Sidebar for Desktop (Admin, PM, Purchase, Billing). Bottom Tab Bar or simple Hamburger menu for Mobile (Site Engineers). Navigation must be highly visible.
layouts.header: Solid background with a hard bottom border. Sticky for quick access to actions.
layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid style for high-level metrics (MRF Ageing, Pending Approvals) with clear hierarchy.

rules: Micro-interactions on all buttons and table rows (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50).
Avoid heavy animations. Stick to simple opacity and subtle translations (e.g., -translate-y-0.5 on card hover).

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to minimum 4.5:1 ratio. No light gray text on white background.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements to support users with limited computer experience using mobile devices on construction sites.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='create-mrf-btn').

media.icons: lucide-react. Use large, legible icons (24px or 32px for mobile actions).
media.images: Use for Auth pages, empty states, or profile avatars. Do not over-clutter the functional dashboard with images.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this B2B enterprise tool unless visualizing a project site plan. Focus on functional clarity with D3.js or Recharts/Shadcn Charts for MRF Ageing and Billing reports.

auth_background.description: Detailed view of a Japanese construction site showcasing steel beams and modern architecture. Great for the login screen background.

hero_alternative.description: Yellow crane near building during daytime. Use for project placeholder images.

team_placeholder.description: Two women in hard hats and uniforms. Use for user profile placeholders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Implement the 5 role-based views using standard routing and conditional rendering.
Ensure the mobile view for Site Engineers is extremely simplified: large 'Create MRF' button, simple list of pending MRFs, and large tap targets.
Use Recharts (or Shadcn Charts) for the MRF Ageing and Billing Engineer dashboards.
Do not use generic Inter or Roboto fonts. Import and configure Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Apply the 'Grid Borders (Technical Look)' surface strategy for tables and data cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined Archetype 4 High-Contrast Swiss design.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern button styles relevant to the app style (rectangular with rounded-md).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or equivalent.
Ensure all components have data-testid attributes for testing.
